method: Convert the existing CMUdict ARPAbet pronunciation symbols to broad IPA; never infer a pronunciation from word spelling. Retain all source variants. Primary variant choices below follow the generated example's reviewed sense or the common dictionary headword form.

read.reason: Present/simple headword read: every morning in the reviewed example; the past-tense variant is retained.

live.reason: Adjective live: a live football game in the reviewed example.

lead.reason: Verb lead: the guide will lead us; the metal-noun variant is retained.

wind.reason: Noun wind: the strong wind blew the leaves.

tear.reason: Noun tear: a tear rolled down her cheek.

bow.reason: Noun bow: a bow made from a branch and string.

close.reason: Adjective close: the hotel is close to the station.

use.reason: Verb use: please use a pencil.

record.reason: Noun record: keeps a record of daily spending.

present.reason: Adjective present: all students were present.

object.reason: Noun object: a strange object appeared.

permit.reason: Verb permit: the rules do not permit visitors.

increase.reason: Verb increase: the shop will increase its prices.

decrease.reason: Noun decrease: expects a small decrease in costs.

graduate.reason: Noun graduate: my sister is a graduate of a university.

content.reason: Noun content: the content of the report.

desert.reason: Noun desert: the hot, dry desert.

minute.reason: Noun minute: every minute of the trip.

refuse.reason: Verb refuse: I refuse to answer.

bass.reason: Noun bass in the reviewed musical sense: the song's deep bass.

resume.reason: Verb resume: the meeting will resume.

advocate.reason: Verb advocate: doctors advocate regular exercise.

conduct.reason: Verb conduct: conduct a science experiment.

conflict.reason: Noun conflict: solve the conflict peacefully.

contract.reason: Noun contract: they signed a contract.

convert.reason: Verb convert: convert a factory into a museum.

convict.reason: Verb convict: a jury may convict him.

deliberate.reason: Adjective deliberate: the damage was deliberate.

estimate.reason: Verb estimate: experts estimate the repairs will take three months.

separate.reason: Adjective separate: keep raw meat separate from vegetables.

attribute.reason: Verb attribute: scientists attribute the rise to human activity.

suspect.reason: Noun suspect: police questioned the suspect.

perfect.reason: Adjective perfect: the weather was perfect.
